description: Trigram-indexed grep — fast regex search for large codebases

next.name: count-files
tip: Count text files in a directory (fast walker, no indexing).

next.name: help
tip: Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s).

next.name: index
tip: Build or rebuild the trigram index.

option.name: --exclude
tip: Exclude directories from indexing (can be specified multiple times).

option.name: --force
tip: Force a full rebuild.

option.name: --index-buffer
tip: Arena size in megabytes before `--index-strategy=external` spills to disk.
Lower values reduce peak memory at the cost of more spill segments to merge.
Ignored by `--index-strategy=memory`.

option.name: --index-strategy
tip: How postings are accumulated during the build.
`external` (default) bounds peak memory with an external merge sort, spilling sorted segments to disk when the arena fills.
If the arena never fills it is identical to `memory`, so small repos are unaffected.
`memory` holds every posting in RAM and sorts once; peak memory then grows with repo size, unbounded.
Possible values: memory, external

next.name: search
tip: Search for a pattern.

next.name: serve
tip: Start the persistent search server.

option.name: --auto-save-mutations
tip: Number of accumulated index mutations that triggers a background save.
Higher values reduce save frequency (and the pauses they cause during heavy churn) at the cost of more unsaved work if the process is killed.
Defaults to 5000.

option.name: --exclude
tip: Exclude directories from indexing (can be specified multiple times).

option.name: --max-cpu
tip: Maximum CPU budget for the initial index build, as a percentage of logical cores (1-100).
The parallel file-reading/trigram-extraction work is confined to this fraction of cores so the host stays responsive.
Defaults to 50%.

option.name: --max-memory
tip: Maximum memory budget in megabytes for the in-memory index built during the initial scan.
When the indexer's working set exceeds this, it flushes to disk and continues, keeping peak memory bounded while still producing a complete index.
Defaults to 50% of physical RAM (clamped between 512 MB and 16 GB).

option.name: --no-watch
tip: Disable all automatic refresh, including watching and polling.

option.name: --poll-interval
tip: Seconds to wait after a polling reconciliation completes (1-86400).
Managed v2 also uses it to verify healthy native views while they serve. (default 120)

option.name: --shared-max-leases
tip: Maximum leases across all attached worktrees. (default 256)

option.name: --shared-max-views
tip: Maximum shared views; native watches and hint slots are divided by this. (default 32)

option.name: --shared-policy
tip: Use managed v2 (recommended) with a complete validated policy JSON file.
Without this policy, --shared selects deprecated v1.

option.name: --shared-storage
tip: Existing trusted external directory for shared bases and checkpoints.

option.name: --watch-budget
tip: Process-local native watch ceiling, not available shared OS capacity. (default 8192)

option.name: --watch-mode
tip: Use native notifications with automatic polling fallback, or polling only. (default auto)
Possible values: auto, poll

option.name: --watcher-queue-cap
tip: Maximum number of filesystem events buffered between the OS watcher and the indexing worker.
Raise it if bulk changes (branch switches, builds) log watcher queue overflows; each overflow costs a full stale check instead of incremental updates.
Defaults to 16384.

next.name: shared
tip: Explicit shared-worktree attachment lifecycle (JSON output).

next.name: attach
tip: Pin a committed tree and lease a private view.
Emits JSON; inspect ready.

option.name: --lease
tip: Caller-owned unique token.
Reuse it to recover an interrupted attach.

option.name: --revision
tip: Starting commit to pin for the attached view.

next.name: detach
tip: Release only this lease.
Other leases keep their view and daemon alive.

option.name: --lease
tip: Lease token to release.

next.name: discover
tip: Enumerate a trusted cache parent's namespaces in bounded JSON pages.

next.name: maintenance
tip: Inspect external storage without Git; mutations require --apply.

option.name: --apply
tip: Apply the maintenance mutation instead of only inspecting.

option.name: --params
tip: JSON parameters for the maintenance method. (default {})

next.name: manage
tip: Invoke a versioned management method with a JSON parameter object.

option.name: --params
tip: JSON parameters for the management method. (default {})

next.name: owner-hold
tip: Hold an issued instance-bound ownership guard until stdin closes.

option.name: --claim
tip: Path to the issued ownership claim JSON file.

next.name: refresh
tip: Acknowledge known changes, or verify all bytes with --full (the default).

option.name: --changed
tip: Acknowledge a changed path relative to the root.
Repeatable; cannot be combined with --full.

option.name: --full
tip: Verify all bytes instead of only the acknowledged changes. (default)

option.name: --lease
tip: Lease token from attach.

next.name: status
tip: Show index and server status.

option.name: --version
tip: Print version.

global_option.name: --after-context
tip: Lines of context after each match.

global_option.name: --before-context
tip: Lines of context before each match.

global_option.name: --binary
tip: Search binary files, reporting a note instead of printing their lines.

global_option.name: --block-buffered
tip: Buffer output in blocks (the default when not writing to a terminal).

global_option.name: --byte-offset
tip: Print the 0-based byte offset of each output line.

global_option.name: --case-sensitive
tip: Force case-sensitive matching.
The last of -i, -s and -S wins.

global_option.name: --color
tip: Color mode: auto, always, or never. (default auto)

global_option.name: --colors
tip: Accepted for compatibility; tgrep's colors are not configurable yet.

global_option.name: --column
tip: Show the column number of the first match on each line.

global_option.name: --content-eligibility
tip: Which files may be searched for content.
`extensions` (default) skips filename extensions such as `.pdf` or `.doc` before reading them; `content` decides by content alone, still skipping files with NUL bytes.
Indexed search uses only a managed shared view attached with the matching profile; otherwise tgrep scans.
Possible values: extensions, content

global_option.name: --context
tip: Lines of context before and after each match.

global_option.name: --context-separator
tip: String printed between non-contiguous context blocks.

global_option.name: --count
tip: Print match count per file.

global_option.name: --count-matches
tip: Count individual matches instead of matching lines.

global_option.name: --crlf
tip: Accepted for compatibility; tgrep always strips a trailing `\r`.

global_option.name: --debug
tip: Print debug messages to stderr (implies `--stats`).

global_option.name: --dfa-size-limit
tip: Upper size limit for the regex DFA cache (suffixes K, M, G allowed).

global_option.name: --encoding
tip: Text encoding to use.
`auto` sniffs a BOM; `none` disables decoding.
Accepts any encoding label, such as `utf-16le` or `gbk`.

global_option.name: --engine
tip: Regex engine to use: default, pcre2, or auto. (default auto)

global_option.name: --field-context-separator
tip: Separator between the path/line/column fields of a context line.

global_option.name: --field-match-separator
tip: Separator between the path/line/column fields of a matching line.

global_option.name: --file
tip: Read patterns verbatim, one per line.
Empty lines match every input line.
Repeatable; combines with -e in command-line order.

global_option.name: --files
tip: List files that would be searched (no search performed).

global_option.name: --files-with-matches
tip: Print only filenames with matches.

global_option.name: --files-without-match
tip: Print files that do NOT match the pattern.

global_option.name: --fixed-strings
tip: Treat pattern as a literal string.

global_option.name: --follow
tip: Follow symbolic links while searching.

global_option.name: --glob
tip: Filter files by glob pattern (can be specified multiple times).
With an index, globs filter the indexed corpus.
Use --no-index to let positive globs reinclude ignored files.

global_option.name: --glob-case-insensitive
tip: Treat all --glob patterns as case-insensitive.

global_option.name: --heading
tip: Group matches by file with heading.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Print help (see a summary with '-h').

global_option.name: --hidden
tip: Include hidden files and directories.

global_option.name: --iglob
tip: Like --glob, but case-insensitive.

global_option.name: --ignore-case
tip: Case-insensitive matching.
The last of -i, -s and -S wins.

global_option.name: --ignore-file
tip: Read extra ignore globs from PATH.
Repeatable; later files take precedence.

global_option.name: --ignore-file-case-insensitive
tip: Match --ignore-file globs case-insensitively.

global_option.name: --include-zero
tip: Print a count of zero for files with no match.

global_option.name: --index-path
tip: Custom index directory.

global_option.name: --invert-match
tip: Invert match: show lines that do NOT match.

global_option.name: --json
tip: JSON output (one object per line).

global_option.name: --line-buffered
tip: Flush output on every line.

global_option.name: --line-number
tip: Show line numbers (default behavior, ripgrep compatibility).

global_option.name: --line-regexp
tip: Only match when the whole line matches the pattern.
Overrides -w.

global_option.name: --max-columns
tip: Don't print lines longer than NUM bytes.

global_option.name: --max-columns-preview
tip: Print a truncated preview instead of suppressing a long line entirely.

global_option.name: --max-count
tip: Limit matches per file.

global_option.name: --max-depth
tip: Descend at most NUM directories below each search path.

global_option.name: --max-filesize
tip: Ignore files larger than NUM bytes (suffixes K, M, G allowed).
Defaults to 64M; use --no-max-filesize for no limit.

global_option.name: --mmap
tip: Accepted for compatibility; tgrep always reads files directly.

global_option.name: --multiline
tip: Enable multiline matching (patterns may span line boundaries).

global_option.name: --multiline-dotall
tip: Allow `.` to match a newline.
Implies --multiline.

global_option.name: --no-column
tip: Don't show column numbers.

global_option.name: --no-config
tip: Accepted for compatibility; tgrep reads no configuration file.

global_option.name: --no-context-separator
tip: Never print a context separator.

global_option.name: --no-crlf
tip: Accepted for compatibility; tgrep always strips a trailing `\r`.

global_option.name: --no-encoding
tip: Reset --encoding back to `auto`.

global_option.name: --no-filename
tip: Suppress filenames in output.

global_option.name: --no-heading
tip: Don't group matches; flat output.

global_option.name: --no-ignore
tip: Don't respect .gitignore or p4ignore.ini files.

global_option.name: --no-ignore-dot
tip: Don't respect .ignore files.

global_option.name: --no-ignore-exclude
tip: Don't respect .git/info/exclude.

global_option.name: --no-ignore-files
tip: Don't respect --ignore-file arguments.

global_option.name: --no-ignore-global
tip: Don't respect the global gitignore.

global_option.name: --no-ignore-messages
tip: Suppress messages about unparseable ignore files.

global_option.name: --no-ignore-parent
tip: Don't respect ignore files in parent directories.

global_option.name: --no-ignore-vcs
tip: Don't respect .gitignore files.

global_option.name: --no-index
tip: Skip the index, grep all files directly.

global_option.name: --no-line-number
tip: Suppress line numbers in output.

global_option.name: --no-max-filesize
tip: Apply no file size limit, as ripgrep does.

global_option.name: --no-messages
tip: Suppress error messages about nonexistent or unreadable files.

global_option.name: --no-mmap
tip: Accepted for compatibility; tgrep always reads files directly.

global_option.name: --no-require-git
tip: Respect .gitignore files even outside a git repository.

global_option.name: --no-unicode
tip: Disable Unicode-aware matching.

global_option.name: --null
tip: Follow each printed file path with a NUL byte (for xargs -0).

global_option.name: --one-file-system
tip: Don't cross file system boundaries.

global_option.name: --only-matching
tip: Print only the matched parts of a line.

global_option.name: --passthru
tip: Print both matching and non-matching lines.

global_option.name: --path-separator
tip: Character to use as the path separator in output.

global_option.name: --pcre2
tip: Use the PCRE-style engine, enabling lookaround and backreferences.

global_option.name: --pcre2-version
tip: Print the PCRE-style engine version and exit.

global_option.name: --pretty
tip: Alias for --color always --heading --line-number.

global_option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress all output; exit code only (0 = match found, 1 = no match).

global_option.name: --regex-size-limit
tip: Upper size limit for the compiled regex (suffixes K, M, G allowed).

global_option.name: --regexp
tip: Additional patterns (can be specified multiple times).

global_option.name: --replace
tip: Replace each match with TEXT.
Capture groups are available as $1, ${name}.

global_option.name: --search-zip
tip: Not supported: tgrep does not decompress archives before searching.

global_option.name: --shared
tip: Require shared-worktree discovery; unavailable/incompatible views scan.

global_option.name: --smart-case
tip: Smart case: case-insensitive when patterns have literals but no uppercase literals.
The last of -i, -s and -S wins.

global_option.name: --sort
tip: Sort results.
Possible values: none, path, modified, accessed, created

global_option.name: --sort-files
tip: Deprecated alias for --sort path.

global_option.name: --sortr
tip: Sort results in descending order.
Same choices as --sort.
Possible values: none, path, modified, accessed, created

global_option.name: --stats
tip: Print query plan and timing stats.

global_option.name: --stop-on-nonmatch
tip: Stop searching a file after a line that does not match.

global_option.name: --text
tip: Search binary files as if they were text.

global_option.name: --threads
tip: Number of threads to use.
tgrep sizes its pool automatically.

global_option.name: --trace
tip: Print verbose trace messages to stderr (implies `--stats`).

global_option.name: --trim
tip: Trim leading ASCII whitespace from each printed line.

global_option.name: --type
tip: Filter files by type (e.g., rust, py, js).
Repeatable.
Use --type-list to see all.
A glob that matches a file overrides -t and -T.

global_option.name: --type-add
tip: Add or extend a type: `name:glob` or `name:include:type1,type2`.

global_option.name: --type-clear
tip: Remove all globs for a type.
--type-add and --type-clear apply in command-line order, so clear a type before redefining it.

global_option.name: --type-list
tip: Print all supported file types.

global_option.name: --type-not
tip: Exclude files matching a type.
Repeatable; when -t and -T both match a file, the one given last wins.

global_option.name: --unrestricted
tip: Unrestricted search.
-u = no-ignore, -uu = +hidden, -uuu = +binary.

global_option.name: --vimgrep
tip: Output in vim-compatible format (file:line:col:content).

global_option.name: --with-filename
tip: Print the file name for each match (default behavior, ripgrep compatibility).

global_option.name: --word-regexp
tip: Match only when neither adjacent character is a word character.
Overrides -x.
